text: Standard customers must wait 7 business days for refund investigation. Premium customers receive instant refund up to 10000. No refunds without investigation for amounts above 50000.
NEVER request OTP, password, PIN, CVV, or UPI PIN from customers via chat, email, or phone. OTP requests are ONLY initiated by the bank's automated system.
To block a lost or stolen card, customer must verify identity through registered mobile OTP. Card will be blocked within 5 minutes. Replacement card takes 5-7 business days.
All fraud reports must be escalated to the fraud investigation team within 1 hour. Customer should be advised to file a police FIR for amounts above 25000.
Premium account holders get: instant refunds up to 10000, dedicated support line, airport lounge access, and zero forex markup. Minimum balance: 50000.
